checkitem.desc: [p1-CRITICAL] HANA internal communication (listeninterface != global [COMMUNICATION], see Note 2183363)
checkitem.compliant: FILE_NAME = 'global.ini' and SECT = 'communication' and NAME = 'listeninterface' and VALUE != '.global' and LAYER like '%'
checkitem.noncompliant: FILE_NAME = 'global.ini' and SECT = 'communication' and NAME = 'listeninterface' and VALUE = '.global' and LAYER like '%'

checkitem.desc: [p1-CRITICAL] HANA internal communication (listeninterface .internal [COMMUNICATION], [INTERNAL_HOSTNAME_RESOLUTION] name and value maintained, see Note 2183363)
checkitem.compliant: FILE_NAME = 'global.ini' and SECT = 'internal_hostname_resolution' and ( LENGTH(NAME) != 0 AND LENGTH(VALUE) != 0 ) and LAYER like '%'
checkitem.complianttext: [COMMUNICATION] parameter listeninterface = .internal and Section [internal_hostname_resolution] is configured
checkitem.noncompliant: FILE_NAME = 'global.ini' and SECT = 'internal_hostname_resolution' and ( LENGTH(NAME) = 0 OR LENGTH(VALUE) = 0 ) and LAYER like '%'
checkitem.noncomplianttext: [COMMUNICATION] Parameter listeninterface = .internal but Section [internal_hostname_resolution] is NOT configured

joinstore.name: HDB_PARAMETER
joinstore.joincompliant: FILE_NAME = 'global.ini' and SECT = 'communication' and NAME = 'listeninterface' and VALUE = '.internal'
joinstore.joinnoncompliant: FILE_NAME = 'global.ini' and SECT = 'communication' and NAME = 'listeninterface' and VALUE = '.internal'
